## Design note

The city's most common car: a five-door supermini that fills traffic queues and parking bays. Light, upright and lazy above 100 km/h, it leans hard, understeers safely and is easy to shove aside — a moving obstacle more than a rival.

## How this car breaks

A modern small-car shell: short crumple zones and a decent HSS cell for its size, but there is little car in front of the cabin, so frontals reach the firewall early and a heavier car's nose goes deep into the doors. Plastic bumpers and thin panels crumple at parking-lot speeds.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2000s 1.3 L FF superminis
- road-test figures for the class (0-100, braking, skidpad)
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, disc/drum brake hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 444 | 0.80 | 360 |
| pitch | 1506 | 0.90 | 1360 |
| yaw | 1553 | 0.92 | 1430 |

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual, open front differential. Layout **FWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.35 × peak torque = 160 N·m. Shift time 0.50 s.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.27 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 313 kg | 1.35 Hz | 22500 N/m | 1430 N·s/m | 2140 N·s/m | 0.15 m |
| Rear | 187 kg | 1.50 Hz | 16600 N/m | 950 N·s/m | 1420 N·s/m | 0.16 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **2320 / 4620 N·s/m F, 1540 / 4090 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.5°/g with 62% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.425 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 45941 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 23353 F / 16989 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **2500 F / 200 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.5°/g, front share 62%. Bump stops 120000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.5° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 3.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 256 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 103 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.103 m = **1793 N·m**
- Rear: 203 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 17.5 mm → A = 2.41 cm², drum radius 102 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **439 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1220 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.47×), rear needs 248 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.78×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 363 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.548** → delivered 1790 N·m front / 363 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 840 N·m per rear wheel.

Ratio 16.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.0 m → outer-front path radius 4.91 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.53 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.608 rad (34.9°)** (outer 30.1°, inner 41.2° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.1 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/tansy_13.json`)

271 nodes, 1774 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id tansy_13 --profile hatch --width 1.67 --length 3.85 --height 1.5 --wheelbase 2.46 --mass 232.8 --car-mass 1058.2 --clearance 0.14 --front-overhang 0.75 --strength 0.9` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 2).
- Era `2000s` passenger cell: 158 cabin/sill, 158 cross-member, 10 pillar, 20 roof rail → hss × 0.90 section.
- Steel hood: 105 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Luggage bay: 13 Cabin nodes behind the rear seatback (y < -1.13 m, rear axle +0.10 m) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell ends at the seatback, as on a real two-box body.
- Transverse engine: gearbox mounted on the left end of the engine block (gen-lattice places it in the tunnel at the firewall, as for FR).
